# tokenkit

> Type-safe JWT encode/decode for Rust with configurable validation, secret
> rotation, key rotation, and revocation support.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): JWT semantics, feature flags, quick start.
- [REQUIREMENTS.md](REQUIREMENTS.md): numbered requirements REQ-TK-001..202 with test traceability.
- [THREAT-MODEL.md](THREAT-MODEL.md): threat model and security mitigations.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): security policy.
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): release history.
